title: Gertie the Dinosaur
studio: Winsor McCay; distributed by Box Office Attractions Co.
contents: McCay finishes his drawing at the dinner party, intertitle 'Gertie... will come out of that cave and do everything I tell her to do', and Gertie emerges, bows, munches a tree and swallows a boulder: the first keyframe-animated character with a personality.
pd_us: US: PD (published 1914; copyright registered 15 Sep 1914, MU228 per the Library of Congress catalogue record https://www.loc.gov/item/2006640653/, long expired). National Film Registry title (1991).
pd_korea: Korea: PD. Korean Copyright Act Art. 42 protects cinematographic works for 70 years from publication (50 years before the 1 Jul 2013 amendment, which did not revive expired works); a film published in 1914 expired at the end of 1984 at the latest, so 1955-or-earlier films are PD. Korea's 1996 Berne restoration only covered foreign works still within the Korean term, so it does not apply.
trademark_caveat: None known. McCay died 1934, so even life+70 rules are satisfied.
audio: none: silent film, the archive copy has no soundtrack
